method: Native Brave screenshots and accessibility readbacks from the authenticated active Shopify theme editor; no browser-private API calls.

catalogue.desktopReview: Scrolled all 32 products. Warm Bone background family, square cards, full silhouettes and consistent spacing. No white-background lead previews remain.
catalogue.mobileReview: Checked top, apparel, middle headwear and final rows. Two columns fit the narrow preview without horizontal overflow or garment cropping. Blue hoodie retains its back design; green tee remains fully visible.

homepage.result: The eight featured cards inherit the updated previews and square containment. Desktop and mobile grids align consistently; existing hero still renders separately.

savedState: Active theme displayed; Save disabled at final review. Desktop preview restored after mobile checks; browser zoom left at 100%.
scopeLimit: Verifies preview presentation and observed product coverage. Does not establish supplier accuracy, a fresh complete variant audit, stock availability, fulfilment readiness or public launch. Product-detail gallery photos are retained.
